test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If A × B means that A is the father of B, A – B means that A is the mother of B, A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal uncle of R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : P ÷ Q × R → P is the brother of Q who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72652039b778966f6948627b1451ebc00935e105751622f7bf9f56262bb91047.png] 

**Here, P is the paternal uncle of R.**

 
• Option - (2) : P ÷ Q – R → P is the brother of Q who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eac891dd650bba4b243c71edb6c2a873790a11ed62959dbc84a22c1958829329.png] 

Here, P is the maternal uncle of R.

 
• Option - (3) : Q ÷ P × R → Q is the brother of P who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14b82e27d6d74c9f4779138d5f7a66af0330c88168bc2ab51696cb46ff1daf33.png] 

Here, P is the father of R.

 
• Option - (4) : P × Q ÷ R → P is the father of Q who is the brother of R.

​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fccceee99a8ac5ab8e4b3c41a776c70a94913f75c162e1a50247e5c0ac4b467c.png] 

Here, P is the father of R.

Thus, out of all the options **only option - (1) shows that P is the paternal uncle of R.**

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
